{{Quote|War will teach your soldiers to be sensible and your generals to be fools.|Balmorran proverb|<ref name="EGTW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>}}
'''Balmorrans''' were the [[Human/Legends|Human]] native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]].<ref name="EGTPM">''[[The Essential Guide to Planets and Moons]]''</ref> Balmorrans were among the most prolific [[weaponsmith]]s and [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] manufacturers in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="Holonet">{{Holonet|planets|balmorra|Balmorra}}</ref>
